methodology.breakoutDefinition: Close crosses the prior 12-bar high/low; no volume or indicator is used to define the event.
methodology.entry: Next 5-minute bar open after the breakout bar closes.
methodology.optionModel: Nearest listed strike, theoretical 0DTE premium with 3% half-spread; no historical option quote or fill data.
methodology.expiryEligibility: SPY/QQQ use weekday sessions; single stocks use Fridays only because 0DTE requires an expiration that day.
methodology.featureTiming: All discovery features end on the bar immediately before the breakout bar.
methodology.split: Sessions before 2026-08-27 are train; 2026-08-27 and later are untouched chronological holdout.
methodology.tradingViewJoin: Only real 5m snapshots timestamped at or before the feature bar and no older than 15 minutes.
